candidates.text: In the safety population (N=24), 19 participants (79.2%) experienced at least one treatment-emergent adverse event. Treatment-related events occurred in 10 participants (41.7%). No severe adverse events or serious adverse events were reported. The most frequently reported preferred term was headache (6 participants, 25.0%).
